reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations and Quarrendon Freight Lines' main contact.

- **Where it came from:** The North cheat sheet (a public note) names her as QFL's main contact. Dana's Aug 20 post in #north-team says Thea flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see that post.
- **Background I included:** One trailer showed up as two 06:30 check-ins because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. I also pointed him to Dana, who has owned the account since June 2025, for the screenshots.
- **Possible mix-up:** Brackenwater Freight Co., an account Marcus took over in Sept 2025, also had appointments doubled up on door 6. If he actually meant Brackenwater, Thea isn't the right contact. I answered for QFL as he asked.

QFL's account folder in the file share came up empty.
